data_source: Rogendo/English-Swahili-Sentence-Pairs, a parallel corpus hosted on Hugging Face
notes: This is a specialized, open-source English-to-Swahili translation dataset built for training conversational AI and translation software. It stands out because it provides over 210,000 verified sentence pairs, moving past generic dictionary terms into real-world conversational phrasing. It is structured to easily plug into modern deep learning frameworks like PyTorch and Hugging Face Transformers.
